entries.speaker: Masked Guest
entries.en: *chuckle* Gazing upon this scenery[n]makes me truly feel that I'm one of[n]the chosen ones.

entries.speaker: Masked Guest
entries.en: Oh dear, I got far too excited in the[n]entertainment hall. I should cool down[n]here for a while.

entries.speaker: Masked Guest
entries.en: That man had so many tattoos...[n]And his mannerisms were quite[n]preposterous as well...

entries.speaker: Masked Guest
entries.en: But I suppose if he's on this ship,[n]Mr. Shido must accept him...

entries.speaker: Bartender
entries.en: Welcome, sir. The back deck is just[n]this way.

entries.speaker: Bartender
entries.en: We are currently on special alert, but[n]do not mind us. Please make yourself[n]at home.

entries.speaker: Bartender
entries.en: The entertainment hall is just near here.

entries.speaker: Bartender
entries.en: We have various games there, including[n]slot machines. I suggest you head there[n]if you are bored.
